basic.name: Cloud Serpent (Q)
basic.description: Summon a Cloud Serpent on target allied Hero that automatically attacks nearby enemies, dealing 26 damage per attack. Lasts for 8 seconds.

basic.name: Blinding Wind (W)
basic.description: Throw a cloud of Blinding Wind at the 2 nearest enemies (prioritizing Heroes), dealing 132 damage. Affected targets miss all Basic Attacks for 2 seconds.

basic.name: Healing Brew (E)
basic.description: Heal lowest Health ally (prioritizing wounded Heroes) for 190 Health.

heroic.name: Jug of 1,000 Cups (R)
heroic.description: Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 66 Health.

heroic.name: Water Dragon (R)
heroic.description: Summon a Water Dragon that hits the nearest enemy Hero after 3 seconds, dealing 318 damage to the target and 50% damage to enemies in the area.

trait.name: Fast Feet (T)
trait.description: Upon taking damage while below 50% Health, gain 10% Movement Speed and Basic Attack damage for 1 second. Can only trigger once every 8 seconds.

1.name: Pitch Perfect
1.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Blinding Wind. Reward: After hitting 10 Heroes, increase the number of targets hit by 1. Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, increase the number of targets hit by 1 more.

1.name: Free Spirited
1.description: Cloud Serpent's duration is increased by 50%.

1.name: Self Less
1.description: Healing Brew also heals you for 50% of the amount healed.

4.name: Serpent Zeal
4.description: While Cloud Serpent is active, the target's Basic Attacks heal them for 50% of the damage dealt.

4.name: Mass Vortex
4.description: Blinding Wind hits 2 additional targets and its Slow is increased to 30%.

4.name: Lingering Blind
4.description: Increase the duration of Blinding Wind's miss effect by 1 second.

7.name: Two for One
7.description: Healing Brew heals the 2 lowest Health allied Heroes for 75% of the normal amount.

7.name: The Good Stuff
7.description: Healing Brew heals for an additional 30 Health over 3 seconds. While Fast Feet is active, this healing is increased by 100%.

7.name: Pick Me Up
7.description: Increases the healing of Healing Brew by 33% if the target is under 50% Health.

10.name: Jug of 1,000 Cups
10.description: Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 66 Health.

10.name: Water Dragon
10.description: Summon a Water Dragon that hits the nearest enemy Hero after 3 seconds, dealing 318 damage to the target and 50% damage to enemies in the area.

13.name: Shake It Off
13.description: Blinding Wind deals 100% additional damage to Heroes and removes 20 Armor from them for 2 seconds.

13.name: Safety Sprint
13.description: Fast Feet grants 20% Movement Speed, decaying over 1 second. Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Fast Feet by 1 second.

13.name: Hindering Winds
13.description: Blinding Wind Slows enemies by 30% for 2 seconds.

16.name: Gift of the Celestials
16.description: Cloud Serpent attacks bounce to 2 nearby enemy Heroes for 50% damage.

16.name: Mistweaver
16.description: Activate to heal all nearby allied Heroes for 74 Health. Can be cast while channeling Jug of 1,000 Cups.

16.name: Cool Breeze
16.description: Reduce the cooldowns of Cloud Serpent and Blinding Wind by 2 seconds.

20.name: Jug of 1,000,000 Cups
20.description: Jug of 1,000 Cups now lasts up to 8 seconds and heals for 75% more.

20.name: Double Dragon
20.description: Water Dragon hits a second Hero for 50% damage and its cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds.

20.name: Let's Go!
20.description: Activate to heal an allied Hero for 140 and make them Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be used on yourself.

20.name: Storm Shield
20.description: Activate to give all nearby allied Heroes a Shield for 20% of their max Health for 3 seconds.
